name: oversized-line
description: (v1.2) A line over 256 KiB (262,144 bytes) is not buffered: the hub sends error -32600, data.id rpc.frame-too-large, id null, then closes that channel. For a module the supervisor counts it as one crash toward the crash bar (7.7). 'peer' is the far end of the module's channel.

steps.event: a peer on module foxglove.example-art's channel sends one line of 300 KiB

data.reason: a message line is at most 256 KiB
